name: braftonium-blocks
description: Builds Braftonium blocks. (1) LEGACY pre-bundled blocks: each keeps its .scss alongside its files (e.g. banner/banner.scss → banner/banner.css); the sass scripts compile the explicit block dirs (NOT '.') so sass never descends into node_modules (npm auto-creates a recursive braftonium symlink there that would otherwise loop forever) — add new legacy block dirs to both sass scripts. (2) MODERN React blocks: authored in src/<slug>/ and compiled by wp-scripts to build/<slug>/ — drop a folder in src/, no script change needed. `npm run build` does both.

scripts.sass-watch: sass --watch banner:banner cta:cta custom-list:custom-list custom-list-item:custom-list-item custom-row:custom-row slide:slide slider:slider --no-source-map
scripts.sass-compile: sass banner:banner cta:cta custom-list:custom-list custom-list-item:custom-list-item custom-row:custom-row slide:slide slider:slider --no-source-map
scripts.build: npm run sass-compile && npm run build:react
